name_en: Green Beans with Garlic and Oil
description_it: Fagiolini lessati e saltati con aglio e olio EVO.
description_en: Boiled green beans sautéed with garlic and EVO oil.
steps_it: Lessare i fagiolini in acqua salata per 8 minuti.
Scolare e saltare in padella con aglio e olio.
steps_en: Boil green beans in salted water for 8 minutes.
Drain and sauté in pan with garlic and oil.
